Maya (CSM): Quick heads-up — QBR for Acme scheduled Tue 2025-04-15 11:00am PT. Need final slide owners + exec Q&A answers. Draft deck: https://redwood.app/slides/acme-qbr-draft
Jonah (AM): Got it. Can you drop which slides still need owners?
Maya (CSM): Still open: onboarding status, latency/cost delta, renewal risks. I can take exec summary + action list.
Priya (CSE): I can own the onboarding status slide. Will include timeline and adoption metrics. @Maya — any specific customer success KPIs you want called out?
Maya (CSM): Please highlight enablement completion %, active features, and 30/60/90 adoption milestones. Keep it one slide.
Alex (Solutions): I'll take metrics & ROI slide (usage, sessions, avg tokens). Which window? 30d or 90d?
Jonah (AM): 90d preferred for execs, but include a 30d trend bullet.
Tom (Eng): Heads-up — I don't have 99th pct latency for calls to the embeddings endpoint yet. Eng infra is investigating a spike.
Nora (CS Ops): I can pull 30-day latency and cost delta. Format preference: table or small chart?
Priya (CSE): Table is best for the onboarding slide. Chart on metrics slide works for Alex.
calendar-bot: Event created: Acme QBR — Dry run Tue 2025-04-15 09:00am PT — invite: maya@redwood.com, jonah@redwood.com, priya@redwood.com, alex@redwood.com
Maya (CSM): Checklist (owners + due dates):
```
- Exec summary: Maya — due Mon EOD
- Onboarding status: Priya — due Mon 10am
- Metrics & ROI: Alex — due Mon 2pm
- Latency/cost table: Nora/Tom — due Mon 3pm
- Renewal risk slide + proposed mitigation: Jonah — due Mon 3pm
```
Priya (CSE): Ack — I'll include short bullet answers to likely exec Qs: (1) adoption blockers (training cadence), (2) time-to-value. Drafting now.
Jonah (AM): Renewal risk note: client asked about reliability + compliance for a broader rollout. Propose we offer a 90-day Dedicated trial + a security review — want that added to mitigation slide.
Alex (Solutions): I can sketch the Dedicated trial slide. Need estimated throughput uplift and cost delta. @Tom @Nora, can you provide numbers?
Tom (Eng): Will grab recent perf reports and send 99/95/50 pcts by EOD today. Also can add a short note about fallback policies.
Nora (CS Ops): Uploaded latency + cost delta snapshot here: https://redwood.app/reports/acme-latency-30d — I'll convert to a table for the deck and tag it in the slide comments.
Maya (CSM): Great progress :thumbsup: Please update the deck directly under the ACME QBR/DRAFT file. I'll compile the final deck Mon 6pm and run a dry-run Tue 9am PT. If anyone expects blockers, flag in this thread.
Alex (Solutions): Noted, will update slide and ping if numbers missing.
Priya (CSE): Will add the exec Qs doc too — sending in thread after I finish the bullets.
Jonah (AM): If we do Dedicated trial, I'll draft the commercial ask and a short timeline. Ping me for review.
Maya (CSM): Thanks all. If no issues, I'll finalize invites and runbook after the dry-run. /cc @calendar-bot
